data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to show a horizontal view of a calendar with a date picker.
data.what_it_does: Shows a horizontal calendar view in a Flutter application allowing users to pick dates. Supports displaying the month and localized calendar formatting through intl and nepali_utils dependencies.
use_when: You need a horizontal date picker component in your UI
You want to display dates in a horizontal scrollable strip
avoid_when: You need a standard vertical grid calendar view
You need advanced event management on the calendar
strengths: Provides a simple horizontal date picker widget
Includes support for locales and null safety
weaknesses: Limited documentation and features beyond basic date selection
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml dependencies.
